headline: Infratil hits fresh high as Nvidia spurs gains across Asia
summary: New Zealand's S&P/NZX 50 joined an Asia-wide rally after Nvidia reported another record quarter. OpenAI is accelerating its IPO push, SpaceX filed IPO paperwork and Anthropic was reported on track for a strong quarter.
why: The NZX 50 is New Zealand's benchmark index of its largest listed companies, and Nvidia is the leading supplier of AI chips.
